integrity: The proof combines an explicit forcing sequence with a full-rank positive semidefinite Gram matrix having the exact graph-power off-diagonal support. Finite verifier results are corroboration, not substitutes for the parameter-uniform proof. No independent external audit has been performed.
limitations: The theorem treats only the ordinary powers of two-row Cartesian path grids for positive power k and length ell at least k+1. No result is claimed for width three or larger, other lengths, or all optimal forcing sets. Literature indexing may be incomplete.
title: Positive semidefinite minimum rank and zero forcing of all ladder powers
